description: This file contains unit tests for the BaseRetireHandler class in the org.openmrs.api.handler package, specifically testing its handle() method functionality on Retireable objects like Location.

classes.name: BaseRetireHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of BaseRetireHandler handling Retireable objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheRetiredBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle() method sets the retired flag to true.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheRetireReason
methods.description: Tests that the handle() method correctly sets the retire reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetRetiredBy
methods.description: Checks that the handle() method sets the user who retired the object.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetRetiredByIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that handle() does not overwrite an existing retiredBy user.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetDateRetired
methods.description: Verifies that the handle() method sets the date retired to the provided date.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetDateRetiredIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures handle() does not overwrite an existing dateRetired.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetTheRetireReasonIfAlreadyVoided
methods.description: Checks that no retire reason is set if the object is already marked as retired.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetRetiredByEvenIfRetiredBitIsSetButRetiredByIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that handle() sets the retire reason even if the object is already marked as retired but retiredBy is null.
